Siddha 365 Health Care Clinic

5.0Out of 5 stars

Overall rating out of 257 Google reviews

SANJAI SJ
a day ago

We are extremely grateful to this Siddha 365 Heath Care Clinic Dr.Sindhu. She is very friendly and treats patients just like a family doctor. My wife’s pregnancy was delayed due to abnormal ANA, and with her Siddha treatment, her ANA levels came back to normal within just one month. We truly felt cared for and guided at every step. Highly recommended doctor for all kinds of health issues. Thank you for your excellent care and support.

4 days ago

Visit ths clinic for my severe sinusitis problem doctor Sindhu mam explained well and good care Life style first ten days symptoms also reduced thank u mam excellent work then follow my regular medication..

Visited for skin issues , I am recovering ,so that I am continuing medication. Good Service ,explanation on skin issues

Last 2 days back I have right rip pain...I meet DR SINDHU V such a excellent treatment and therapy... medicine 💯 percent natural... now I have no pain...

prasanna muthuraman
2 weeks ago

Getting treatment for skin allergy symptoms. Feeling better now. Doctor sindhu clearly explained abt the issue and remedy. Thank you so much doctor.

Suresh Masilamani
2 weeks ago

We came to Siddha 365 for respiratory problem. Now symptoms reduced much better. Thanks to Sindhu Mam

Naga Jothi
3 weeks ago

Constipation and vericose vein I have suffered from constipation longtime . And felt severe leg pain . After vising clinic am diagnosed vericose vein. Taking treatment for 1 month completely recovered from constipation. Vericose vein problem starts recover rapidly . Now I am pain free . Thank you mam

Manikandan Baburaj
3 weeks ago

Came here for cough issues for my mom. Doctor explained the issues clearly and made good follow up.Got but much betterment after 10 days of medication

DANISH M.
a month ago

My sister was suffering from severe fever with cold and cough we came here to consult doctor sindhu she is a kind and noble person who heard all my sister's health condition clearly and gave some medicines with extra tips to cure the fever and cold.I thought that okay it would take definitely two or three weeks but Just 3 days everything turned normal. Surprisingly she became very active like how she used to be before. My heartful thanks to Dr sindhu who consulted my sister with patience and helped her to cure her disease thanks Mam

Ameer Jaco
a month ago

After a long journey filled with hope , patience and prayers,today our dream has finally come true..the infertility treatment gave us not just medical support but emotional strength and confidence..after 5 months have infertility treatment we are pregnant... pregnancy was confirmed and successful..we are forever grateful for the doctor sindhu mam support our dream into reality.. Hope is real ,,and miracles do happen.. thank u dr sindhu mam

Lakshan
4 months ago

My granny visited Siddha 365 Health Care Clinic for her joint pain, and the results have been amazing. She used to struggle a lot with walking, but after the treatment here, she is now able to walk comfortably and feels so much better. The doctor treated her with great care and attention.Truly grateful for their effective and natural treatment — highly recommend this clinic for anyone dealing with joint pain!

Ramya Radhakrishnan
3 weeks ago

I visit ths clinic for my irregular period taken proper medicine then period are regular .. after one month I got my pregnancy positive ..now am pregnant . My husband also had problem ( low motility ) he also took a medicines for 2 months , after medicine his motility rate improved . Now we got pregnancy positive

Mangala Valli
a month ago

Within few months there was remarkable improvement on fertility issues morphology and motility are increased personalized care diet guidance we finally increased thank u mam right diagnosis and patience good care

Sundari Bala
a month ago

Visit this clinic for uterus bulky and thickened endometrium taken 2 months of medication proper cycle excellent medicine and very effective thank u mam . My frds and family also reffered

mukesh logu
5 months ago

I had a very positive experience with the Sidha doctor during my recent consultation. The doctor was highly knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to clearly understand my health concerns before suggesting treatment. I truly appreciated the natural and holistic approach to healing that was recommended, which not only addressed my symptoms but also focused on the root cause of the issue I would highly recommend this Sidha doctor to anyone seeking effective method of healing. Thank you

Likitha Reddy
3 months ago

We visited Sindhu ma'am for infertility..We have seen the real change within 2 months of consuming medicine. We have consulted so many doctors but haven't seen any visible difference like here...best recommended for infertility.
